verdict.rationale: Signifyd's docs show a broad first-party REST API covering core fraud workflows (Checkout/Sale events, decisions, chargebacks, representments, webhooks, sensitive-data protection) which are the same operations exposed in its merchant dashboard, suggesting substantial parity. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming that all UI-only functions (e.g., policy/rule configuration in Decision Center, case management, analytics/reporting UI) are also API-accessible, so full parity is not evidenced. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for policy/rule configuration, case-review/analytics dashboards, and any documented API-vs-UI feature parity statement.
